messages:
sam_support: FYI we have a high-severity ticket — customer reports being charged twice for the same requests after client retries following timeouts. Invoice delta ~+2x tokens for one spike. attaching summary below.

rita_billing: Can you paste the customer invoice id and the sample request IDs? I need to map tokens -> ledger entries.

sam_support: Invoice ID INV-2025-2338, customer reported request IDs in UI = `req_01G2XZ...` (shortened). Their support repro shows repeated identical prompt w/ ~same token counts. Customer says they saw a 504, retried from client.

omar_eng: Do we have gateway logs for that time window? Important: whether requests had `Idempotency-Key` or unique `x-request-id`. If no idempotency header, gateway -> backend retries could cause double charge.

maya_sre: I pulled proxy logs for 1749054300-1749054400. Gateway did a 2nd delivery to serving runtime for the same client IP ~28s later. No `Idempotency-Key` header present on either attempt. gateway retry policy is default (5s, 2x on 504/timeout).

sam_support: Customer client was old SDK v0.9.5; their code snippet didn't set `Idempotency-Key`. They said they thought retries were client-side only. Repro steps from them:
```
# naive retry (no idempotency)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Hello world", "max_tokens":512 }' # client sees 504, retries after 30s
```
When we replay the same prompt from customer account we see two consumptions.

omar_eng: That matches an at-least-once delivery pattern. If no `Idempotency-Key` every retry is a new request and will consume tokens. We treat each successful downstream response as billable.

rita_billing: We should credit the customer for the duplicate run(s). Sam, please open a portal credit for INV-2025-2338 for the duplicate token delta and mark as support remediation. I'll review policy for manual credit.

maya_sre: Short-term mitigation: update support KB to call out that older SDKs must include `Idempotency-Key` for potentially retried calls. Long-term: we should add server-side heuristics to detect likely duplicates when: same account, same prompt size, same client IP and same content within 60s window, even if no idempotency header.

omar_eng: Agreed. Proposed engineering tasks: 1) Add dedupe-by-header: if `Idempotency-Key` present, dedupe across retries (low-risk). 2) Add best-effort content-hash dedupe for no-key cases (needs safety checks). 3) Emit explicit billing tags on duplicate-detected requests so billing job can roll back.

sam_support: Owners: rita -> issue credit (ETA 24h). omar -> PR for `Idempotency-Key` dedupe (ETA 3d). maya -> add KB note + anomaly alert (ETA EOD). I'll notify customer and apply interim credit hold.

deploy-bot: deploy/service/gateway v2.14.1 rolled at 1749056000 (planned) — will include logging knobs for `Idempotency-Key` dedupe metric (no behavior change until PR merged). :gear:

rita_billing: Thanks. Once credit processed I'll post refund tx id here. Also will we proactively scan last 7 days to find other similar spikes?

omar_eng: I'll run a quick query on the metrics store for sudden token deltas per account and flag if >1.8x baseline in 1h. If we find matches, we'll queue them for manual review.

sam_support: Customer update: told them we identified cause (client retries + missing idempotency), offered credit while we investigate mitigations. They appreciated the fast response. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: Action log summary: CREDIT_PENDING -> ENG_DEDUPE_PR -> KB_UPDATE -> METRIC_SCAN. I'll add runbook notes for the oncall to escalate similar cases.

rita_billing: Marking ticket scope as "billing double-charge due to retries" and assigning billing credit. Will follow up with invoice adjustment.
